_README: TEMPLATE — applied by scripts/agy-access.ps1 -Apply. Read config/agy-permissions.md first.
THE TWO RULES THAT MATTER, both established by experiment on 2026-08-06:
1. Rules must match the FULL command token-for-token. There is no prefix
matching. `command(npm)` does NOT permit `npm run test`. `command(npm run
typecheck)` permits exactly that string. Verified both directions.
2. --sandbox must be OFF. In sandbox mode a terminal command additionally
requires the `escalate_admin` permission, which headless mode cannot prompt
for, so every command is denied. You get the sandbox OR shell commands,
never both.
The posture this produces is DEFAULT-DENY: anything not listed below is
auto-denied because headless mode cannot ask. That is much stronger than
allow-everything-minus-a-denylist. Verified: `del do-not-delete.txt` was
refused and the canary file survived, while `git status` ran.
Keys and entries beginning with _ are notes and are stripped before applying.
The driver enforces the deny set, not the script. agent.agy.ts carries a
non-negotiable MINIMUM_DENY (plus a self-protection rule on this settings
file itself) and refuses any UNSANDBOXED run whose settings.json is missing
a rule — reason AGY_PERMISSIONS, no provider call. The stronger rules added
2026-08-11 (git remote/credential, Clear-Content, attrib, node -p, python3 -c,
powershell -EncodedCommand, irm, ...) are a CONTRACT CHANGE: they take effect
on the next -Apply. Until then the deployed set still satisfies MINIMUM_DENY.
command(npm run lint) was removed here because no such script exists anymore
